# Lighthouse morning report

This issue summarizes the nightly Lighthouse run and lists concrete fixes the team should consider. The team will review and decide which to apply.

Workflow run: https://github.com/musukvl/ai-for-developers-project-387/actions/runs/36925872943
Artifact (HTML/JSON): available on the workflow run under Artifacts -> `lighthouse-morning-report`
Hosted HTML report: https://storage.googleapis.com/lighthouse-infrastructure.appspot.com/reports/1790888562860-99540.report.html

Summary (from reports/lighthouse-latest.md generated 2026-10-01T21:02:32.688Z)

- Performance: 100
- Accessibility: 94
- Best Practices: 96
- SEO: 90

Audits to review

- Browser errors were logged to the console: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found)
- Background and foreground colors do not have a sufficient contrast ratio (low contrast text)
- Document does not have a meta description
- Eliminate render-blocking resources: `/assets/index-*.css` (score 50)

Recommended fixes (ordered by impact) — tie to Lighthouse audit

1. Fix low-contrast header link (Accessibility)
   - Audit: "Background and foreground colors do not have a sufficient contrast ratio"
   - Why: Low-contrast text prevents many users from reading the header link. Accessibility score is 94.
   - Suggested change: Update the header brand link color to meet WCAG AA (4.5:1) on the header background (for example use white or another accessible color). Verify with Lighthouse and a contrast checker.

2. Add a favicon so /favicon.ico does not 404 (Best Practices / Console error)
   - Audit: "Browser errors were logged to the console" (404 for /favicon.ico)
   - Why: Lighthouse records console errors as Best Practices degradations. Fixing the missing favicon will remove the 404 entry.
   - Suggested change: Add `frontend/public/favicon.ico` (or reference an SVG/PNG favicon from `index.html`) so the request succeeds.

3. Add a meta description (SEO)
   - Audit: "Document does not have a meta description"
   - Why: SEO score is 90 specifically because the page lacks a meta description. A short one-line summary improves search snippets.
   - Suggested change: Add `<meta name="description" content="Calls Calendar — lightweight calendar for scheduling calls and meetings">` (or a suitable sentence).

4. Review render-blocking CSS (Performance / Eliminate render-blocking resources)
   - Audit: "Eliminate render-blocking resources" — `assets/index-*.css` (score ~50)
   - Why: The CSS flagged is small (~4 KiB) and Performance is already 100; this is low priority but worth noting if you change the critical CSS strategy later.
   - Suggested change: Consider inlining critical CSS or deferring non-critical stylesheet loading if you need to further improve first-paint timing on constrained networks.

Notes

- Full HTML and JSON reports are attached to the workflow run as the `lighthouse-morning-report` artifact. Use the workflow run link above and download the artifact to view the full Lighthouse HTML report.
- `reports/lighthouse-latest.md` was generated by the CI and is the single-file summary. `reports/lighthouse-fixes.md` already lists similar recommended fixes; no changes were required there for this run.

Next steps for the team

- Review the recommendations in the morning meeting and assign the fixes by priority and owner.
- For small changes (favicon, meta description, header color), open focused PRs with Conventional Commit messages, for example: `fix: add favicon.ico` or `fix: add meta description`.
